notes: Performance-only expression/gaze/head-pose combos. Deliberately does NOT touch face shape, eye color, ethnicity, age, hair identity, or freckle density -- identity comes from IDENTITY_ANCHOR/LENA_MASTER_IDENTITY/SKIN_REALISM elsewhere in the prompt. Each entry composes into exactly one short prompt line via format_expression_gaze_line(). attitude_level (2026-07-08, Visual Hook / Allure Gate follow-up) added to every combo (neutral/moderate/high), read by _expression_attitude_weight() in lena_prompt_brain.py as an additive selection-weight bonus -- never a hard filter. exp_g003/exp_g005/exp_g011 (pre-existing) and 2 new combos (exp_g016, exp_g017) are tagged high; the rest are neutral/moderate, unchanged in content.
